## Joint resolution

This key does not map on its own.

**Figma — `autoVsAbsoluteLayout`.** On the READ side these keys are not read from single Figma properties at all. relateAutoVsAbsoluteLayout computes position, the four insets and the two centre offsets from node.constraints plus geometry and parent dimensions (ADR-041). width and height are nulled when the matching layoutSizing is HUG or FILL; layoutSizing is nulled for an absolutely positioned child.

Participating keys: `position`, `top`, `bottom`, `start`, `end`, `centerHorizontalOffset`, `centerVerticalOffset`, `layoutSizingHorizontal`, `layoutSizingVertical`, `width`, `height`.

**React — `autoLayoutSizing`.** Resolved against facts about the PARENT, not this element: the parent layoutMode axis and the parent crossAxisAlignment. FILL emits flex:1 0 0 on the parent main axis, width/height:100% across it, and NOTHING when the parent cross-stretches. HUG emits fit-content unless the parent main axis already hugs.

Participating keys: `layoutSizingHorizontal`, `layoutSizingVertical`.
